note: Which deployed contracts evidence each registry ABI export. roles: addresses.ts role keys (every chain that lists them); instances: representative deployments for interface-shaped ABIs. Read by scripts/capture-registry-abi.mjs, scripts/gen-registry-abis.mjs, scripts/gen-source-globals.mjs and test/registry-abi.test.ts. An export's ABI is the union of its deployments' full verified ABIs (gen-registry-abis.mjs), and a role's deployment that does not run one of its functions as declared has it withheld on its chain, or served there as it declares it (gen-source-globals.mjs), so a deployment that differs needs no entry here. returns: the registry ABI an address a function returns speaks, by the function's signature and, for a field of what it returns, the field names after it ("poolInfo(uint256).crvRewards"). standard: on an interface whose instances are examples of an ERC or a protocol's interface, why: its ABI is its reference interface alone (reference/index.json), each function where every instance dispatches it; the instances' verified ABIs still check each declaration. common: on an interface whose instances run different implementations, why: its ABI is only what every instance dispatches and declares alike. overloads: signature -> why, the overload kept where several of one name take as many arguments (otherwise the registry's, then the most dispatched). default: on a role's export, why its contract is the one `<Protocol>.<method>(…)` calls where the protocol has several. delegates: getters whose answer a contract delegates to, its fallback (Comet's extensionDelegate()) or its functions (Euler EVault's MODULE_TOKEN() and the other modules), each captured as a layer. logs: event signatures whose newest real log the capture records for the test to decode. exempt: an interface instance whose verified declaration legitimately differs; unverified: a function no verified ABI declares, with why the deployed bytecode is the evidence (a reference interface's function names its source); unverifiable: an export nothing on-chain can evidence; required: a signature a consumer binds; probes: signatures to ask a selector router about where its inventory has none; unresolved: a facet of a per-selector router's inventory (reference/index.json `inventories`) that no deployment reaches, and why.
